root_cause_analysis.issue: Courier panel pages (Vardiyalar, Muhasebe) returning 403/401 errors
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: 4 backend routers (shifts.py, accounting.py, hakedis.py, break_system.py) had require_admin router-level dependency. Couriers have role=courier, not admin, so they got 403 Forbidden.
root_cause_analysis.fix_applied: Changed router-level dependency from require_admin to require_auth in 4 files
root_cause_analysis.verification: All endpoints now return 200 with courier token, 401 without token. Frontend pages load correctly.
